verdict.rationale: Shopify's webhook system lets developers subscribe to events and trigger custom actions ('a trigger to perform an additional action after that event has occurred'), which supports event-driven automation, but this requires writing app/webhook code rather than a declarative 'define rules' interface accessible to an AI-native (non-developer) user. Missing for 10: evidence of a native no-code rule builder (e.g., Shopify Flow) with trigger-condition-action UI, and any AI-specific mechanism for autonomously defining such rules.
